layout_architecture.overview: Calm, focused command workspace dominated by a live browser viewport (Center-65%), surrounded by a slim left navigation sidebar (Skills/Memory/Files/History/Settings), a collapsible right activity & live log drawer, and a floating bottom command bar with live voice microphone visualizer.
layout_architecture.grid_structure: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] p-4 bg-[#08090E]

key_panels.live_browser_viewport: col-span-1 lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col bg-[#0F111A] border border-[#262B3D] rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl relative
key_panels.right_activity_drawer: col-span-1 lg:col-span-4 flex flex-col bg-[#12141C] border border-[#262B3D] rounded-xl overflow-hidden p-4 space-y-4
key_panels.bottom_command_bar: fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[90%] max-w-3xl z-40 bg-[#181B26]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#00F0FF]/30 shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] rounded-2xl p-3 flex items-center gap-3
key_panels.recording_banner: absolute top-3 right-3 z-30 flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#FF3B30]/20 border border-[#FF3B30]/50 text-[#FF3B30] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-bold animate-pulse

live_browser_remote.description: Interactive screenshot stream / HTML canvas feed showing active Chrome tabs, custom URL bar, tab manager, action markers (click targets, typed text overlays), and manual takeover toggle button.
required_elements: Tab bar with active site favicon, tab title, close tab button, and '+' new tab button
URL address bar with back, forward, refresh buttons, SSL lock indicator, site URL input, and 'Take Over Control' toggle
Screen viewer overlay showing agent cursor (custom neon target icon) clicking elements or typing in real-time
Status badge ('Autonomous Mode', 'Learning User Routine', or 'Manual Mode')

watch_me_recording.description: Procedure recorder that observes user clicks, keystrokes, dialog dismissals, and downloads to automatically auto-synthesize reusable automation skills.
required_elements: Red glowing RECORD button ('Watch Me')
Live step recorder ticker showing captured steps in real-time (e.g. 'Clicked #login-btn', 'Entered email into input')
Stop & Save Skill modal with skill name, natural language trigger description, and step parameters

skills_editor.description: Library of learned procedures with plain-language step inspector, step reordering, parameter variables ($EMAIL, $FILE_PATH), and run trigger tests.
required_elements: Skill search & filter by category (Auth, Data Extraction, File Processing)
Step timeline editor with drag handle, action type dropdown, target selector, and fallback rule
'Execute Now' button with live progress progress bar

approval_modal.description: High-priority safety modal for risky browser operations (e.g., submitting payments, deleting records, executing code, or uploading sensitive files).
required_elements: Dark translucent overlay (`bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md`)
High contrast danger border (`border-[#FF3B30]`)
Clear task detail card showing action URL, proposed payload, and risk level
Three distinct choices: 'Approve Action', 'Reject Task', and 'Always Allow for this Domain'
data-testid attributes for testing modal response

command_bar_voice.description: Bottom natural language prompt input with voice microphone input button, active thinking state waveform visualizer, and agent mode switch.
required_elements: Microphone button with audio activity ring effect when listening
Natural language prompt text input with placeholder 'Tell Shadow what to automate or research...'
'Run Shadow' submit button with cyan illumination
Quick prompt chip recommendations (e.g., 'Download monthly invoice', 'Log into portal & export CSV')

memory_page.description: Persistent memory facts CRUD manager where Shadow remembers user credentials (encrypted), site workflows, modal handling preferences, and file destinations.
required_elements: Memory category tabs (User Preferences, Site Credentials, Custom Selectors, Learned Workflows)
Searchable facts table with edit inline and copy buttons
'Add Memory Fact' dialog component

files_panel.description: Integrated download & upload file repository synced with the browser's download manager and local storage.
required_elements: Recent downloads list with file extension badges, size, timestamp, and 'Open File' / 'Re-upload to Agent' actions
Drag and drop target zone for quick file upload into agent browser session

permissions_page.description: Granular safety and domain permission manager for browser automation.
required_elements: Toggle cards for: Auto-download files, Auto-fill passwords, Dialog box auto-dismissal, Payment confirmation requirement

settings_openai.description: Configuration center for OpenAI API key, browser viewport resolution, headless vs headful mode, and proxy settings.
required_elements: Masked OpenAI API Key input with test connection status pill
Model selection dropdown (e.g. gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, o3-mini)
Save settings notification toast integration

signin_clerk_mock.description: Sleek tactical auth interface matching Clerk component styling with SSO options, email OTP magic link, and enterprise login.
required_elements: Obsidian card container with subtle subtle grid pattern
GitHub, Google, and Email sign-in options
Shield security badge

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade React application for 'Shadow' - Autonomous AI Browser & Process Automation platform.
Implement JS/JSX files only (no TS files). Use Lucide React icons for tactical controls.
Ensure dark mode is the core primary aesthetic with crisp 1px borders (#262B3D) and high-density command center layout.

Provide interactive mock backend states for: Live Browser Screenshot Canvas Stream, Watch-Me Step Recording with red pulsing indicator, Skill Step Editor, Memory Facts CRUD, File Manager, Task Log Ticker, Voice Mic Pulsing Animation, and Safety Approval Modals.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, popovers, or floating menus; always use solid/blurred cards (#181B26 with opacity & border).
Include explicit hover states with text contrast (e.g. `hover:bg-cyan-500/20 hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors`).
Add `data-testid` attributes to every button, link, input, tab, modal, and key metric for reliable end-to-end testing.
